### Fixed
- **The `helm.sh/chart` label is valid for any chart version.** The label is `<name>-<version>` cut to 63 characters, and the cut of a long version (a branch build's `X.Y.Z-dev.<branch>.<date>.<time>.h<sha7>`, or the `<tag>+<digest>` helm-controller installs) could end in `.`, `_` or `--.`, which the API server refuses for every labelled object. The muster and muster-crds helpers now trim the whole run of `-`, `.` and `_` at the ends of the cut, and a helm-unittest suite renders the label for such versions. ([#1319](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1319))
